surprising and will mislead compilation checks.

update.title: RISC-V: Consider spills in conv-dynamic LMUL [PR127075].
update.body:
This patch makes -mrvv-max-lmul=conv-dynamic spill aware.
As reported by Anton, Peter in PR127075, we don't consider spilling when
letting the LMUL decision just be dependent on the size ratio of largest
and smallest type.  This causes spills when building x264 with the
conv-dynamic mode.

Although the original idea was to have a more deterministic approach
than pure "dynamic", determinism alone is not too helpful when spills
are still possible.

Thus, this patch merges the spill estimate of "dynamic" into
"conv-dynamic" and also corrects some slight mistakes in "dynamic".
I factored out the lmul-comparison logic into its own function so
better_main_loop_than_p is a bit easier to follow.  While at it, I
renamed some functions and computed the type size ratio in add_stmt_cost
which is much more straightforward than before.

	PR target/127075

gcc/ChangeLog:

	* config/riscv/riscv-vector-costs.cc (compute_estimated_lmul):
	Rename...
	(estimate_lmul): ...To this.
	(compute_lmul_from_conversion_ratio): Remove.
	(costs::compute_live_ranges_and_lmul): Remove param.
	(costs::compute_conversion_dynamic_lmul): Remove.
	(costs::has_unexpected_spills_p): Rename...
	(costs::has_spills_p): ...To This.
	(costs::record_lmul_spills): Adjust comment.
	(costs::record_potential_unexpected_spills): Rename...
	(costs::record_potential_spills): ...To this.
	(costs::compare_lmul_to): New function.
	(costs::better_main_loop_than_p): Call new function.
	(costs::record_type_sizes): New function.
	(costs::add_stmt_cost): Call new function.
	(costs::finish_cost): Compute type ratio for LMUL.
	* config/riscv/riscv-vector-costs.h: Declare new function.

gcc/testsuite/ChangeLog:

	* gcc.dg/vect/costmodel/riscv/rvv/pr127075.c: New test.

update.title: OpenMP: Add the 'scaled' modifier to the 'simdlen' clause [PR127723]
update.body:
This OpenMP 6.1 (TR14) feature was added to handle the fancier
simdlen variants of AArch64/RISC-V.

Namely, besides 'simdlen(length)' there is now also an optional scale
factor:
  simdlen( scaled(arith-type [, divisor]) : length )
with the scaling factor defaulting to one when absent and otherwise being
  max(1, round_down(VL(type) / divisor))
and VL(type) is a target & type specific value, which might be only
known at runtime (divisor and length must be >= 1 and constant).
And 'type' is an arithmetic type (C/C++) or numeric intrinsic type
(Fortran).

The 'simdlen' with 'scaled' can be specified on 'declare simd', on
the 'simd' directive and - as context selector - on 'declare variant'.

This commit adds support for C and C++, only, and currently fails with
a sorry in gimplify_scan_omp_clauses and simd_clone_clauses_extract.

	PR middle-end/127723

gcc/ChangeLog:

	* attribs.cc (omp_declare_simd_clauses_equal): Handle
	simdlen's type and divisor of the scaled modifier.
	* omp-general.cc (resolve_omp_target_device_matches,
	omp_construct_simd_compare): Likewise.
	* gimplify.cc (gimplify_scan_omp_clauses): Remove
	simdlen clause with a sorry when it has a scaled modifier.
	* omp-simd-clone.cc (simd_clone_clauses_extract): Likewise.
	* tree-core.h (enum omp_clause_code): Update comment for
	OMP_CLAUSE_SIMDLEN.
	* tree-pretty-print.cc (dump_omp_clause): Handle scaled
	modifier to simdlen.
	(dump_omp_context_selector): Fix dumping of simd trait.
	* tree.cc (omp_clause_num_ops): OMP_CLAUSE_SIMDLEN takes
	now three operands.
	* tree.h (OMP_CLAUSE_SIMDLEN_TYPE,
	OMP_CLAUSE_SIMDLEN_DIVISOR): New defines.

gcc/c/ChangeLog:

	* c-parser.cc (c_parser_omp_clause_simdlen): Handle
	simdlen's type and divisor of the scaled modifier.
	* c-typeck.cc (c_finish_omp_clauses): Add comment
	about safelen vs. simdlen with scaled.

gcc/cp/ChangeLog:

	* parser.cc (cp_parser_omp_clause_simdlen): Handle
	simdlen's type and divisor of the scaled modifier.
	* pt.cc (tsubst_omp_clauses): Likewise
	* semantics.cc (finish_omp_clauses): Likewise;
	add comment about safelen vs. simdlen with scaled.

gcc/testsuite/ChangeLog:

	* c-c++-common/gomp/simdlen-scaled-1.c: New test.
	* c-c++-common/gomp/simdlen-scaled-2.c: New test.

update.title: RISC-V: Added DT_RELR support
update.body:
Porting by referring aarch64 and loongarch implementations.

RISC-V and loongarch both have relaxations, so there is also the same thing
that it's not safe to do relaxations when updating the section layouts for relr.

For relr readelf, added is_riscv_special_symbol_name to filter following
special symbols:
1. mapping symbols
2. __DATA_BEGIN__, __SDATA_BEGIN__ and __BSS_END__, which are only used for
counting gp in riscv.

=====
v3 changelog,
1. Rebase onto current trunk.
2. Place .dynamic after .data in relr-relocs.ld.  Since the linker
   creates its own dynobj, the orphan .dynamic went before the .data.*
   orphans and broke relr-data.
3. Fix the .riscv.attributes typo in relr-relocs.ld.
4. Add relr-got-start and relr-addend tests, ported from LoongArch, and
   a relr-relax test for relaxation deleting bytes before packed relocs.
5. Add a NEWS entry.
6. Add RISC-V to the ld.texi entry for -z pack-relative-relocs.

=====
v2 changelog,
1. rebasing test cases
2. Only enable dt_relr for linux rather than elf toolchain in
   ld/emulparams/elf32lriscv-defs.sh

Co-Authored-By: Kito Cheng <kito.cheng@sifive.com>
update.author: Nelson Chu

items.summary_zh: 为 RISC-V 添加 DT_RELR 相对重定位支持，参考 AArch64 和 LoongArch 实现；涵盖链接器生成 .relr.dyn、readelf 过滤 RISC-V 特殊符号、RISC-V 下的松弛安全性处理及相关测试和文档。
items.impact_zh: 这是一项新功能，可让 RISC-V 使用 DT_RELR 压缩相对重定位；但与松弛存在交互，需确保更新节布局时不做不安全松弛。当前信息仅表示上游提交已合入，未确认是否通过测试或在 RuyiSDK/binutils 中默认启用。
items.packaging_advice_zh: 建议人工核对 binutils 版本是否包含完整 DT_RELR 支持，并结合 ld-riscv-elf 新增 relr 测试、-z pack-relative-relocs 选项及实际链接场景验证；注意确认该项新功能是否经过目标工具链测试和发布流程。

update.body:
In the PRs we hit the same problem as before, just this time with a
(subreg:TF (reg:V4SF)) pun on a 32-bit target and a complex int128.
These are different quadword splits than before but they can be
handled similarly.  This patch extends riscv_subpart so it
can deal with sub-parts of arbitrary modes.  The new functionality
is then used to move a spilled TFmode value in word-sized chunks.

	PR target/127547

update.title: RISC-V: Compute live ranges for pattern results
update.body:
When a stmt is replaced by a pattern stmt during vectorization, the
existing live range calculation code still calculates the live range of
the original variable, and mark it as alive from the beginning of the
block.  Changing that to a live range of the pattern result can lead to
a more precise register pressure estimation.

The testcase is generated by LLM by adapting the x264 pixel_avg loop.
We used the vanilla pixel_avg loop as the testcase downstream because
our downstream version has other issues that overestimate the required
register number.  The adapted case, although not directly encountered in
benchmarks, can show that the estimation can be improved on the trunk,
at least for cases like this, too.

Regtested on rv64gcv and rv32gcv, no regression.

Assisted-by: Codex

gcc/ChangeLog:

	* config/riscv/riscv-vector-costs.cc (get_pattern_var): New
	function.
	(costs::compute_local_live_ranges): Replace the argument with
	the pattern result when necessary.

gcc/testsuite/ChangeLog:

	* gcc.dg/vect/costmodel/riscv/rvv/dynamic-lmul4-5.c: Remove
	xfail.
	* gcc.dg/vect/costmodel/riscv/rvv/dynamic-lmul4-7.c: Ditto.
	* gcc.target/riscv/rvv/autovec/pr121910.c: Change expectation.
	* gcc.dg/vect/costmodel/riscv/rvv/dynamic-lmul8-16.c: New test.
update.author: garthlei

items.summary_zh: 改进 RISC-V 向量化成本模型：当语句被模式语句替换时，改为计算模式结果的活跃范围，而非原始变量的活跃范围，以提高寄存器压力估算精度。
items.impact_zh: 该变更可能改善 RVV 动态 LMUL 选择和寄存器压力估算，但属于启发式优化，可能带来代码生成差异。上游提交称已对 rv64gcv/rv32gcv 回归测试无回归，但元数据未提供完整测试结果，RuyiSDK 实际影响需核对。
items.packaging_advice_zh: 建议在包含 RVV 成本模型优化的工具链中核对该提交；重点运行 gcc.dg/vect/costmodel/riscv/rvv/dynamic-lmul4-5.c、dynamic-lmul4-7.c、dynamic-lmul8-16.c 及 pr121910.c，并评估对动态 LMUL 决策的影响。

update.title: RISC-V: Add conditional negate expansion [PR126245]
update.body:
Add a neg<mode>cc expansion for integral comparisons on RISC-V.

The expansion implements:

  X ? -X : X

as:

  CMP = condition ? 1 : 0
  MASK = -CMP
  RESULT = X ^ MASK
  RESULT += CMP

This pattern can be used by  existing if-conversion paths. Use a
separate pseudo for the XOR result so that the output pseudo is
assigned only once.

gcc/ChangeLog:
	PR target/126245
	* config/riscv/riscv.md (neg<mode>cc): Add an expansion for
	conditional negation of integral values.

gcc/testsuite/ChangeLog:
	PR target/126245
	* gcc.target/riscv/pr126245-negcc.c: New test.

Signed-off-by: Naveen <naveen.siddegowda@oss.qualcomm.com>
update.author: naveengowda-gcc

items.summary_zh: 为 RISC-V 添加条件取负展开：对整数比较结果将 X ? -X : X 展开为比较掩码、XOR 和加法序列，供现有 if-conversion 路径使用（PR126245）。
items.impact_zh: 该变更为整数条件取负操作提供新的展开方式，可能改善某些 if-conversion 场景下的代码生成，但不改变架构支持。当前仅见上游提交已合入，未确认在目标工具链中的测试和发布状态。

update.title: [PATCH][PR tree-optimization/126462] Fix reassociation exposing rotate+xor to work correctly for int128 and BitInt
update.body:
This has been pending in my queue for a while.   Just keeps getting pushed
down.

As the PR notes, I added a patch a while back that could reassociate an xor
operation out of certain sequences which in turn would allow the sequence to be
recognized as rotate+xor.

That patch did not handle 128 bit integers as I used the HOST_WIDE_INT
interfaces.  Similarly it didn't handle BitInt.

This patch changes it to use the wi:: interfaces which fix the code generation
issue on aarch64 with int128 and allow the sequence to safely fire for BitInt.
The recommendations for adjustment were Jakub's.

Bootstrapped and regression tested on x86, aarch64 and riscv. Crosses also
tested without regressions, though I don't think they provide meaningfully more
coverage for int128 and BitInt.

	PR tree-optimization/126462
gcc/
	* match.pd (reassociate xor to expose rotate patterns): Rewrite using
	wi:: interfaces for the xor constant operand.

gcc/testsuite/
	* gcc.dg/torture/pr126462.c: New test.
update.author: JeffreyALaw

items.summary_zh: GCC 树优化修复：重写 match.pd 中用于暴露 rotate+xor 模式的 xor 常量处理，从 HOST_WIDE_INT 接口改为 wi:: 接口，使 int128 和 _BitInt 场景也能正确参与重关联，并新增 torture 测试 pr126462.c。提交说明提到已在 x86、aarch64、RISC-V 上引导并回归测试。
items.impact_zh: 这是通用中间端缺陷修复，RISC-V 是验证平台之一；可能避免 int128/_BitInt 相关优化阶段产生错误代码或错过 rotate+xor 识别。但元数据仅代表上游已合入，不能证明 RuyiSDK 所用 GCC 版本已包含该提交，也不能证明对应构建/测试通过。实际影响需结合目标 GCC 分支和 RISC-V 后端回归结果确认。
items.packaging_advice_zh: 若打包 RISC-V GCC，需人工核对提交是否已进入目标版本分支或需要回合；评估 match.pd 改动对向量/标量优化的回归风险，并至少在 RISC-V 上运行相关 torture 用例。上游声称已测试，但仍需本地构建和回归验证后再决定合入发布包。

update.title: LoongArch: Enable shared library and PIE support for loongarch*-elf
update.body:
loongarch*-elf withholds GENERATE_SHLIB_SCRIPT and GENERATE_PIE_SCRIPT,
so ld refuses -shared and -pie for it.  The exclusion arrived with the
original LoongArch ld port, copied from the RISC-V emulparams, and no
reason was recorded for it either.  loongarch*-elf does not set
EMBEDDED.

The rationale is the one given for the RISC-V patch in this series; it
applies here unchanged.

ld/
	* emulparams/elf32loongarch-defs.sh (GENERATE_SHLIB_SCRIPT): Set
	unconditionally rather than only for non-loongarch*-elf targets.
	(GENERATE_PIE_SCRIPT): Likewise.
	* emulparams/elf64loongarch-defs.sh (GENERATE_SHLIB_SCRIPT):
	Likewise.
	(GENERATE_PIE_SCRIPT): Likewise.

Assisted-by: Claude:claude-opus-5
Signed-off-by: Mintsuki <mintsuki@protonmail.com>

update.title: string: Drop always_inline from tst-xbzero-opt [BZ #23130]
update.body:
Commit a066c5d7d keeps always_inline on prepare_test_buffer unless the
compiler lacks indirect_return, as a proxy for swapcontext not being
returns_twice.  GCC has indirect_return on RISC-V, which uses the
generic bits/indirect-return.h, so the test asks to inline a caller of
a returns_twice function and fails to build:

  tst-xbzero-opt.c:122:1: error: function 'prepare_test_buffer' can
  never be inlined because it uses setjmp

Remove the attribute and the condition around it.

Tested on x86_64 and sparc64.

Reported-by: Andreas Schwab <schwab@suse.de>
Signed-off-by: Stian Halseth <stian@itx.no>
Reviewed-by: Adhemerval Zanella  <adhemerval.zanella@linaro.org>
update.author: shalseth

items.summary_zh: glibc 测试用例修复：从 string/tst-xbzero-opt.c 的 prepare_test_buffer 上去掉 always_inline 属性及相关条件。提交说明指出 RISC-V GCC 具有 indirect_return，使用 generic bits/indirect-return.h，导致测试请求内联调用 returns_twice 的函数而构建失败；该修补已在 x86_64 和 sparc64 上测试。
items.impact_zh: 修复 RISC-V 上 glibc 测试构建失败问题，不改变 glibc 运行库功能代码。元数据仅代表上游已合入，测试中未提及 RISC-V 平台验证；需确认该测试调整能否在目标 RISC-V 工具链和 glibc 版本上通过。
items.packaging_advice_zh: 如果 RuyiSDK 维护 glibc 包并运行其测试套件，需人工确认该提交已进入目标 glibc 版本/分支；建议在 RISC-V 上执行 string/tst-xbzero-opt 构建和测试，验证不再出现 setjmp 内联错误。此改动仅影响测试，不涉及运行库功能代码。

update.title: elf: Only build THP tests for ABIs that define THP-PAGE-SIZE
update.body:
The THP tests added by 53d909a283085c82bdcc71e1cf06c0899506b664 only
make sense for ABIs that support THP. Also, some ABIs have a strict
limit for the PT_LOAD alignment value; for instance, on arc, the
large alignment makes the R_ARC_S25W_PCREL branch from __start to
__libc_start_mainn in the static tests exceed its +-16 6MB range.

Explicit disable the tests on ABIs that do not support it, but
setting THP-PAGE-SIZE to 0 and define a suitable value for each
ABI:

* aarch64: 32MB (16KB base pages; 4KB uses 2MB, 64KB uses 512MB which
  is larger than MAX_THP_PAGESIZE).

* arc: 2MB (MMUv4 only; the kernel supports 2MB and 16MB super pages,
  but a 16MB PT_LOAD alignment can not be linked on arc.

* arm: 2MB (LPAE only).

* i386: 4MB (non-PAE PGD level huge page; PAE and 64-bit kernels use
  2MB).

* loongarch: 32MB (default 16KB base pages; 4KB uses 2MB, 64KB uses
  512MB which is larger than MAX_THP_PAGESIZE).

* mips: 32MB (16KB base pages on 64-bit and 32-bit huge TLB layouts;
  4KB uses 2MB, 64KB uses 512MB which is larger than MAX_THP_PAGESIZE).

* powerpc: 16MB (book3s64 only; hash MMU with 64KB base pages uses
  16MB, radix uses 2MB).

* riscv: 2MB (64-bit only).

* s390: 1MB (segment size).

* sparc: 8MB (sparc64 only, unchanged).

* x86_64: 2MB (also for x32).

The remaining Linux ABIs (alpha, csky, hppa, m68k, microblaze, or1k,
and sh) do not support transparent huge pages and no longer build the
THP tests.

Tested with a 'make check run-built-tests=no' on all affected ABIs
and checked on x86_64-linux-gnu and aarch64-linux-gnu.

Reviewed-by: Carlos O'Donell <carlos@redhat.com>
update.author: zatrazz

update.title: middle-end: fix self-test fails [PR127618]
update.body:
The recent self tests I added should use min_out_nelts
instead of in_nelts.coeffs[0] otherwise for VLA we use the wrong
encoding.

This was missed before because I forgot that an aarch64 bootstrap by
default is VLS not VLA.

Bootstrapped Regtested on aarch64-none-linux-gnu --with-arch=armv9-a
and no issues.

also checked

- rv64gc
- rv64gcv_zvl128b
- rv64gcv_zvl256b
- rv64gcv_zvl512b
